# Donorbox

> Donorbox is a comprehensive fundraising platform that helps nonprofits and other mission-driven organizations collect online and in-person donations, manage donor relationships, run campaigns and events, and build recurring support.

Donorbox serves organizations of different sizes and cause areas. Its fundraising suite includes donation forms and pages, recurring donations, peer-to-peer fundraising, crowdfunding, memberships, event ticketing, donor management, a nonprofit CRM, text giving, QR-code giving, and in-person payment tools. Use the linked product pages as the source of truth for current features, eligibility, availability, integrations, and plan details.

## Start Here

- [Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/): Official homepage and overview of the Donorbox fundraising platform.
- [Explore Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/explore): Hub for Donorbox products, features, solutions, integrations, and comparisons.
- [About Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/explore/about-us): Company background, mission, and information about Donorbox.
- [Features](https://donorbox.org/features): Overview of Donorbox's core platform capabilities.
- [Security](https://donorbox.org/security): Information on how Donorbox protects donor and organization data.
- [Nonprofit Blog](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog): Donorbox's library of fundraising guides, how-tos, and nonprofit best practices.

## Core Fundraising Products

- [Donation Forms](https://donorbox.org/explore/donation-forms): Customizable online donation forms designed to make giving fast and simple.
- [Donation Pages](https://donorbox.org/explore/donation-pages): Secure, customizable Donorbox-hosted fundraising pages with built-in donation forms.
- [Recurring Donations](https://donorbox.org/explore/recurring-donations): Tools for accepting and managing recurring gifts and monthly giving programs.
- [Peer-to-Peer Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/peer-to-peer-fundraising): Enables supporters to create individual fundraising pages for an organization's campaign.
- [Crowdfunding](https://donorbox.org/explore/crowdfunding-platform): Goal-based online fundraising campaigns with tools for engaging supporters.
- [Events](https://donorbox.org/explore/events): Fundraising event pages, ticketing, automated receipts, and ticket tax-value management.
- [Memberships](https://donorbox.org/explore/memberships): Monthly and annual membership programs for building sustained supporter relationships.
- [Text-to-Give](https://donorbox.org/explore/text-to-give): Lets supporters access a campaign and give through text messaging.
- [QuickDonate](https://donorbox.org/explore/quick-donate): A faster way for returning donors to give again through the Donorbox donor portal.
- [Donation Receipts](https://donorbox.org/explore/donation-receipts): Automated and customizable donation receipts for donors.

## Donor Management and CRM

- [Nonprofit CRM](https://donorbox.org/explore/nonprofit-crm): Donorbox CRM for donor data, segmentation, communications, activity tracking, and fundraising insights.
- [Donor Management](https://donorbox.org/explore/donor-management): Tools for organizing donor records, gifts, communications, and supporter relationships.

## In-Person Fundraising

- [Donorbox Live Kiosk](https://donorbox.org/explore/live-kiosk): Turns a compatible tablet and card reader into a self-service cashless donation kiosk.
- [Donorbox Live Mobile](https://donorbox.org/explore/live-mobile): Mobile tool for accepting in-person contactless donations.
- [Scan-to-Donate](https://donorbox.org/explore/scan-to-donate): QR-code fundraising that directs supporters to an organization's donation page.
- [Tap to Pay](https://donorbox.org/explore/tap-to-pay-lp): Information about accepting contactless in-person donations with Tap to Pay.
- [Live Kiosk for Islamic Nonprofits](https://donorbox.org/explore/live-kiosk-[redacted]): In-person kiosk fundraising tailored to mosques and Islamic organizations.

## Website and Payment Options

- [Donation Widget](https://donorbox.org/explore/donation-widget): Embeddable donation form widget for accepting donations on an organization's website.
- [WordPress Donation Plugin](https://donorbox.org/explore/wordpress-donation-plugin): Adds Donorbox donation forms and fundraising functionality to WordPress websites.
- [Squarespace Donations](https://donorbox.org/explore/squarespace-donations): Guidance for accepting donations through a Squarespace website with Donorbox.
- [Wix Donations](https://donorbox.org/explore/wix-donations): Guidance for adding Donorbox fundraising tools to a Wix website.
- [Weebly Donations](https://donorbox.org/explore/weebly-donations): Guidance for accepting donations on a Weebly website with Donorbox.
- [Webflow Donations](https://donorbox.org/webflow-donation): Guidance for embedding Donorbox donation forms on a Webflow website.
- [PayPal for Nonprofits](https://donorbox.org/explore/paypal-for-nonprofits): Information about accepting PayPal and other supported payment methods through Donorbox.
- [Stripe Donations](https://donorbox.org/explore/stripe-donations): Information about processing online donations with Stripe and Donorbox.
- [Accepting Stock Donations](https://donorbox.org/accept-stock-donations): Information on accepting stock and securities gifts through Donorbox.
- [Accepting Crypto Donations](https://donorbox.org/accept-crypto-donations): Information on accepting cryptocurrency gifts through Donorbox.

## Integrations

- [QuickBooks Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/quickbooks-integration): Connects Donorbox fundraising data with QuickBooks accounting workflows.
- [HubSpot Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/hubspot-integration): Connects Donorbox donor and donation data with HubSpot.
- [Blackbaud Altru Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/blackbaud-altru-integration): Connects Donorbox fundraising data with Blackbaud Altru.
- [Salsa CRM and Salsa Engage Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/salsa-crm-salsa-engage-integration): Connects Donorbox data with Salsa CRM and Salsa Engage.
- [Bloomerang Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/bloomerang-integration): Connects Donorbox donation information with Bloomerang donor management.
- [Neon CRM Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/neoncrm-integration): Connects Donorbox fundraising activity with Neon CRM.
- [ActiveCampaign Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/activecampaign-integration): Connects Donorbox supporter data with ActiveCampaign marketing automation.
- [Mailchimp Integration](https://donorbox.org/mailchimp-integration): Connects Donorbox donor data with Mailchimp email marketing.
- [Zapier Integration](https://donorbox.org/zapier-integration): Connects Donorbox to thousands of other apps through Zapier automations.
- [Salesforce Integration](https://donorbox.org/salesforce-integration): Connects Donorbox fundraising data with Salesforce.
- [Kindful Integration](https://donorbox.org/explore/kindful-integration): Connects Donorbox donation data with Kindful donor management.
- [Little Green Light Integration](https://donorbox.org/little-green-light-integration): Connects Donorbox donation data with Little Green Light CRM.
- [Xero Integration](https://donorbox.org/xero-integration): Connects Donorbox fundraising data with Xero accounting.
- [Shopify Integration](https://donorbox.org/shopify-integration): Connects Donorbox donation collection with a Shopify storefront.
- [Rock RMS Integration](https://donorbox.org/rock-rms-integration): Connects Donorbox donation data with Rock RMS, commonly used by churches.
- [Planning Center Integration](https://donorbox.org/planning-center-integration): Connects Donorbox donation data with Planning Center, commonly used by churches.
- [Double the Donation Integration](https://donorbox.org/double-the-donation): Surfaces employer matching-gift opportunities to Donorbox donors.

## Solutions by Organization and Cause

- [Fundraising for Nonprofits](https://donorbox.org/explore/fundraising-for-nonprofits): Overview of Donorbox fundraising tools for nonprofit organizations.
- [Charity Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/charity-fundraising): Fundraising tools for registered charities.
- [Church Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/church-fundraising): Online and in-person giving tools for churches and Christian organizations.
- [Faith-Based Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/faith-based-fundraising): Overview of Donorbox giving tools for faith communities across religions.
- [Catholic Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/catholic-fundraising): Giving tools for Catholic parishes and organizations.
- [Baptist Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/baptist-fundraising): Giving tools for Baptist churches and organizations.
- [Islamic Charity Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/fundraising-for-islamic-charities): Fundraising tools for mosques and Islamic charities.
- [Mosque Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/mosque-fundraising): Giving tools built for mosques.
- [Jewish Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/jewish-fundraising): Fundraising tools for synagogues and Jewish organizations.
- [Temple Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/temple-fundraising): Donation and donor-management tools for temples and faith communities.
- [Animal Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/animal-fundraising): Fundraising solutions for animal shelters, rescues, and welfare organizations.
- [Arts Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/arts-fundraising): Fundraising tools for arts and cultural organizations.
- [Museum Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/museum-fundraising): Fundraising and membership tools for museums.
- [University Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/university-fundraising): Digital fundraising tools for universities and higher-education institutions.
- [School Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/school-fundraising): Fundraising tools for K-12 schools.
- [PTA Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/pta-fundraising): Fundraising tools for parent-teacher associations.
- [Medical Research Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/medical-research-fundraising): Fundraising tools for medical research organizations and campaigns.
- [Disaster Relief Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/disaster-relief-fundraising): Rapid-response fundraising tools for disaster relief organizations.
- [Political Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/political-fundraising): Online fundraising tools for eligible political campaigns and organizations.
- [Capital Campaign Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/capital-campaign-fundraising): Tools for running large-scale capital campaign fundraising.

## Fundraising Calculators and Tools

- [Average Donation Amount Calculator](https://donorbox.org/average-donation-amount-calculator): Calculates an organization's average donation amount.
- [Gift Range Calculator](https://donorbox.org/gift-range-calculator): Builds a gift range chart for capital campaign planning.
- [Donation Form Fitness Calculator](https://donorbox.org/donation-form-fitness-calculator): Scores a donation form's conversion-readiness.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://donorbox.org/zakat-calculator): Calculates Zakat obligations for Muslim donors.

## Plans

- [Pricing](https://donorbox.org/pricing): Donorbox platform fees and pricing details.
- [UK Pricing](https://donorbox.org/uk-pricing): Donorbox pricing details for UK-based organizations.
- [Donorbox Pro](https://donorbox.org/explore/pro): Advanced fundraising features and lower platform fees for growing organizations.
- [Donorbox Premium](https://donorbox.org/explore/premium): Enterprise-level fundraising tools, onboarding, and personalized support.

## Comparison

- [Donorbox vs. Zeffy](https://donorbox.org/explore/donorbox-vs-zeffy): Comparison of Donorbox and Zeffy fundraising platforms.
- [Givebutter vs. Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/explore/givebutter-vs-donorbox): Comparison of Givebutter and Donorbox fundraising platforms.
- [Donorbox vs. Flipcause](https://donorbox.org/explore/donorbox-vs-flipcause): Comparison of Donorbox and Flipcause fundraising platforms.
- [GiveWP vs. Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/explore/givewp-vs-donorbox): Comparison of GiveWP and Donorbox for accepting online donations.
- [DipJar Alternative](https://donorbox.org/explore/dipjar-alternative): Donorbox in-person fundraising options as an alternative to DipJar.

## Featured Blog Guides

A curated selection of the Donorbox nonprofit blog's strongest current guides, out of 1,500+ posts. See the Nonprofit Blog link above for complete coverage.

- [Thank You for Donation Quotes](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/thank-you-for-donation-quotes): Quotes and messages for thanking donors after a gift.
- [Thank You Messages for Church Members' Support](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/thank-you-messages-church-members-support): Sample thank-you messages for church congregations and donors.
- [Ministry Name Ideas](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/ministry-name-ideas): Ideas and guidance for naming a church ministry.
- [Bingo Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/bingo-fundraising): How to run a bingo fundraiser, including rules and prize ideas.
- [Church Vision Statements](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/church-vision-statements): Examples and guidance for writing a church vision statement.
- [Fundraising Sites for Nonprofits and Individuals](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/fundraising-sites-for-nonprofits-and-individuals): Overview of online fundraising site options.
- [Church Welcome Speech](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/church-welcome-speech): Examples and tips for writing a church welcome speech.
- [How Organizations Without 501(c)(3) Status Can Raise Funds](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/ways-organizations-without-501c3s-can-raise-funds): Fundraising options for organizations without 501(c)(3) status.
- [Church Mission Statements](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/church-mission-statements): Examples and guidance for writing a church mission statement.
- [509(a)(2) Public Charity](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/509a2-public-charity): Explains 509(a)(2) public charity status and requirements.
- [Statement of Faith](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/statement-of-faith): Guidance and examples for writing a church statement of faith.
- [GoFundMe Alternatives](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/gofundme-alternatives): Comparison of GoFundMe alternatives for nonprofit fundraising.
- [Pastor Appreciation Month](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/pastor-appreciation-month): Ideas for recognizing pastors during Pastor Appreciation Month.
- [501(c)(3) vs. 501(c)(6)](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/501c3-vs-501c6): Explains the difference between 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(6) nonprofit status.
- [How to Check Nonprofit Status](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/check-nonprofit-status): How to verify an organization's nonprofit status.
- [Zeffy Alternatives](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/zeffy-alternatives): Comparison of Zeffy alternatives for nonprofit fundraising.
- [Fundraising Ideas for Church](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/fundraising-ideas-for-church): Fundraising idea list for churches and faith communities.
- [Raffle Ideas](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/raffle-ideas): Ideas and guidance for running a nonprofit raffle.
- [How to Raise Money for Charity](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/how-to-raise-money-for-charity): General guidance on raising money for a charitable cause.
- [Get Started with Donorbox](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/get-started-with-donorbox): Onboarding guide for new Donorbox users.

## Blog Categories

Topic categories covering the full Donorbox nonprofit blog.

- [Nonprofit Tips](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/nonprofit-tips): General tips and best practices for nonprofits.
- [Resources](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/resources): General nonprofit resource guides.
- [Start a Nonprofit](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/start-a-nonprofit): Guides on starting and registering a nonprofit.
- [Donorbox Academy](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/donorbox-academy): Educational guides and tutorials from the Donorbox Academy.
- [Product Updates](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/product-updates): Announcements and updates about Donorbox product features.
- [Donorbox Integrations](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/donorbox-integrations): Posts on Donorbox's third-party integrations.
- [Compare Fundraising Platforms](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/compare-fundraising-platforms): Comparisons of fundraising platforms and tools.
- [Donor Management](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/donor-management): Posts on donor management and relationship-building.
- [Nonprofit CRM](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/nonprofit-crm): Posts on nonprofit CRM and donor database tools.
- [Payments](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/payments): Posts on payment processing for nonprofits.
- [Crowdfunding](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/crowdfunding): Posts on crowdfunding strategies and campaigns.
- [Peer-to-Peer Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/peer-to-peer-fundraising): Posts on peer-to-peer fundraising campaigns.
- [Event Ticketing](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/event-ticketing): Posts on fundraising event ticketing.
- [Nonprofit Membership Program](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/nonprofit-membership-program): Posts on running nonprofit membership programs.
- [Text-to-Give Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/text-to-give-fundraising): Posts on text-to-give fundraising.
- [Raffles](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/raffles): Posts on running nonprofit raffles.
- [Giving Season](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/giving-season): Posts on year-end and holiday giving season fundraising.
- [Best Nonprofit Organizations](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/category/best-nonprofit-organizations): Posts profiling notable nonprofit organizations.

## Optional

- [Case Studies](https://donorbox.org/case-studies): Real nonprofit success stories using Donorbox.
- [Giving Season Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/giving-season-fundraising): Donorbox tools and guidance for year-end and seasonal fundraising.
- [GivingTuesday Fundraising](https://donorbox.org/explore/giving-tuesday-fundraising): Donorbox tools and guidance for GivingTuesday campaigns.
- [GivingTuesday Resources](https://donorbox.org/giving-tuesday-resources): Additional resources and guides for GivingTuesday campaigns.
- [Virtual Fundraising Events](https://donorbox.org/virtual-fundraising-events): Guidance for planning and running virtual fundraising events.
- [Terms of Service](https://donorbox.org/explore/terms): General terms governing use of Donorbox.
- [Acceptable Usage Policy](https://donorbox.org/explore/acceptable-usage-policy): Rules describing acceptable use of the Donorbox platform.
- [Subscription Terms](https://donorbox.org/explore/subscription-terms): Terms applying to Donorbox subscription plans and services.
- [Sitemap](https://donorbox.org/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of the main Donorbox site.
- [Blog Sitemap Index](https://donorbox.org/nonprofit-blog/sitemap_index.xml): Full XML sitemap index covering all 1,500+ nonprofit blog posts.
